title: All of Us
label: ch:bn-all-of-us
canDo: I can talk about more than one of us, more than one of you and more than one of them, and say what belongs to any of those groups.

payoff.summary: The plural ending taught two chapters earlier on nouns turns out to build every plural pronoun in the language without one exception, and a different ending replaces it when the pronoun has to own something — the first sight of the rule that the back slot holds one suffix at a time.
payoff.note: No plural pronoun of any person existed in the corpus, so possession was available for exactly two of the six persons the proxy enumerates.
